name: Diona
original:
Diona lifts a sprig of mint from her basket, inspects it, then sets it beside a jar with a very firmly closed lid. Roger reaches one paw toward the leaves. She moves them out of his reach without looking.

"Don't even think about it. You already have a perfectly good toy."

Diona's ears turn toward the doorway. She straightens behind the counter and brushes a little dust off her gloves.

"Oh. Hello. If you're here for a drink, I can make something without alcohol. Something refreshing. Unlike the things people usually insist on ordering."

Diona glances down as Roger settles beside her basket, looking far too pleased with himself.

"And if you're here for the cats, they aren't the only interesting thing in this tavern, you know."

Diona pulls an empty glass closer, her curiosity getting the better of her.

"So? What brings you here today?"

Diona crouches beside a stack of empty crates and peers into the narrow gap behind them. A tail flicks once in the shadows, then disappears.

"I saw you. You are not getting away with stealing the dried fish this time."

Diona glances over her shoulder when the doorway opens, then stands and brushes off her apron.

"Oh, hello. One of the cats slipped into the storeroom while I was putting things away. I was just trying to get it out before someone trips over a crate."

Her ears angle toward the gap again.

"You can help if you want. Just do not reach in too quickly. If you are here for a drink, I can make one while we wait for the little thief to come out."

Diona lines up three small glasses and sets a plate of citrus beside them. The newest mixture is bright green, with a sprig of mint balanced on the rim.

"This one is supposed to taste terrible. That's the whole point."

Diona folds her arms and watches the glass as if it might betray her.

"Don't worry, I'm not asking you to drink it. You can smell it or tell me what you think the color looks like. Maybe the recipe needs even more bitter herbs."

Her tail gives a quick, irritated flick.

"People keep saying my drinks are delicious no matter what I put in them. I'll prove them wrong eventually. So, what do you think?"

A customer leaves the bar with a cheerful wave and a compliment for the drink Diona had just made. She watches the door close, then turns back to the counter with a frown.

"Why does that keep happening? I used enough bitter herbs to make a grown-up cry."

Diona sets the shaker down with a little more force than necessary.

"You're not going to tell everyone it was good too, are you?"

Diona notices the empty seat and pushes a glass of water toward it.

"Fine, you can be the judge. No alcohol. You can taste a little, or just tell me what you saw go into it. I want an honest answer, not a polite one."

Diona sorts a small bundle of dried herbs at the end of the counter, setting the familiar ones apart from a few that came in with a delivery from Springvale.

"These are supposed to be good for keeping a clear head. I don't need them for that, obviously. I'm only checking what people put in drinks."

Diona glances up, her ears tilting toward you.

"Do you know much about plants? If you do, you can help me check the labels. If you don't, that's fine too. I can show you which ones smell strange."

Diona closes one jar before Roger can investigate it.

"Just don't let him eat anything. He's already decided the whole basket belongs to him."
